\(\frac{\text{लाभ}}{CP} = \frac{3}{10}\) या 3:10.

question.en: The difference between cost price and selling price of an article is Rs. 720. Loss percentage is 30 percent. What is the selling price of the article? [GD Constable, 06 May 2026, Shift 3]
question.hi: किसी वस्तु के क्रय मूल्य तथा विक्रय मूल्य के बीच का अंतर 720 रुपये है। हानि प्रतिशत 30 प्रतिशत है। वस्तु का विक्रय मूल्य क्या है? [GD Constable, 06 May 2026, Shift 3]

solution.en:
The difference between CP and SP equals the absolute loss value, which is \(30\%\) of CP.
\(30\% \text{ of CP} =\) Rs.720 \(\implies \text{CP} = \frac{720 \times 100}{30} =\) Rs.2400.
\(\text{Selling Price (SP)} = \text{CP} - \text{Loss} = 2400 - 720 =\) Rs.1680.
solution.hi:
क्रय मूल्य (CP) और विक्रय मूल्य (SP) के बीच का अंतर हानि मूल्य के बराबर होता है, जो CP का \(30\%\) है।
\(30\% \text{ of CP} =\) Rs.720 \(\implies \text{CP} = \frac{720 \times 100}{30} =\) Rs.2400.
\(\text{विक्रय मूल्य (SP)} = \text{CP} - \text{हानि} = 2400 - 720 =\) Rs.1680.

question.en: An article is sold for a loss Rs. 98. Loss percentage is 28 percent. What is the selling price of the article? [GD Constable, 06 May 2026, Shift 2]

solution.en:
Let Cost Price (\(CP\)) = \(X\).
Given \(\text{Loss} = 28\%\) of \(CP = 98\):
\(\frac{28}{100} \times X = 98\)
\(X = \frac{98 \times 100}{28} = \frac{7 \times 100}{2} = 350\)
So, \(CP =\) Rs. 350.
Selling Price (\(SP\)) = \(CP - \text{Loss} = 350 - 98 =\) Rs. 252.

question.en: The profit earned on selling an article for Rs. 1200 is 9 times of the loss incurred on selling the same article for Rs. 1000. What will be the selling price of the article to earn a profit of 20 percent? [GD Constable, 06 May 2026, Shift 2]
question.hi: किसी वस्तु को 1200 रुपये में बेचने पर हुआ लाभ, उसी वस्तु को 1000 रुपये में बेचने पर हुई हानि का 9 गुना है। 20 प्रतिशत लाभ कमाने के लिए उस वस्तु का विक्रय मूल्य क्या होगा? [GD Constable, 06 May 2026, Shift 2]

solution.en:
Let the Cost Price of the article be \(CP\).
\(\text{Profit at Rs. 1200} = 1200 - CP\)
\(\text{Loss at Rs. 1000} = CP - 1000\)
According to the problem:
\(1200 - CP = 9 \times (CP - 1000)\)
\(1200 - CP = 9CP - 9000\)
\(10CP = 10200 \implies CP = 1020\) Rs.
To earn a 20% profit, the new selling price is:
\(SP = 1020 \times \frac{120}{100} = 102 \times 12 = 1224\) Rs.
solution.hi:
माना वस्तु का क्रय मूल्य \(CP\) है।
\(\text{1200 रुपये पर लाभ} = 1200 - CP\)
\(\text{1000 रुपये पर हानि} = CP - 1000\)
प्रश्न के अनुसार:
\(1200 - CP = 9 \times (CP - 1000)\)
\(1200 - CP = 9CP - 9000\)
\(10CP = 10200 \implies CP = 1020 \text{ रुपये}\)
20% लाभ कमाने के लिए, नया विक्रय मूल्य है:
\(SP = 1020 \times \frac{120}{100} = 1224 \text{ रुपये}\)।

solution.hi:

question.en: 30 percent of the cost price of an article is equal to the 25 percent of its selling price. What is the profit percentage? [GD Constable, 08 May 2026, Shift 2]
question.hi: किसी वस्तु के क्रय मूल्य का 30 प्रतिशत उसके विक्रय मूल्य के 25 प्रतिशत के बराबर है। लाभ प्रतिशत क्या है? [GD Constable, 08 May 2026, Shift 2]

solution.en:
Let cost price be \(CP\) and selling price be \(SP\).
Given, \(30\% \text{ of } CP = 25\% \text{ of } SP\)
\(\frac{30}{100} CP = \frac{25}{100} SP \Rightarrow 30 CP = 25 SP \Rightarrow \frac{SP}{CP} = \frac{30}{25} = \frac{6}{5}\).
Profit = \(SP - CP = 6 - 5 = 1\).
Profit percentage = \(\frac{\text{Profit}}{CP} \times 100 = \frac{1}{5} \times 100 = 20\%\).
solution.hi:
माना क्रय मूल्य \(CP\) और विक्रय मूल्य \(SP\) है।
दिया है, \(30\% \times CP = 25\% \times SP \Rightarrow \frac{SP}{CP} = \frac{30}{25} = \frac{6}{5}\)।
लाभ = \(6 - 5 = 1\) इकाइयाँ।
लाभ प्रतिशत = \(\frac{1}{5} \times 100 = 20\%\)।

question.en: Cost price of an article is Rs. 6800. The profit percentage is 30 percent. What is the selling price of the article? [GD Constable, 08 May 2026, Shift 1]
question.hi: एक वस्तु का क्रय मूल्य 6800 रुपये है। लाभ प्रतिशत 30 प्रतिशत है। वस्तु का विक्रय मूल्य क्या है? [GD Constable, 08 May 2026, Shift 1]

solution.en:
Selling Price (SP) = Cost Price (CP) + Profit
Profit \(= 30\% \text{ of } 6800 = \frac{30}{100} \times 6800 = 2040\).
SP \(= 6800 + 2040 =\) Rs. 8840.

question.en: 20 percent of the cost price of an article is equal to the 25 percent of its selling price. What is the loss percentage? [GD Constable, 08 May 2026, Shift 1]
question.hi: किसी वस्तु के क्रय मूल्य का 20 प्रतिशत उसके विक्रय मूल्य के 25 प्रतिशत के बराबर है। हानि प्रतिशत क्या है? [GD Constable, 08 May 2026, Shift 1]

solution.en:
Given: \(20\% \text{ of CP} = 25\% \text{ of SP}\)
\(\frac{20}{100} \times CP = \frac{25}{100} \times SP \implies \frac{SP}{CP} = \frac{20}{25} = \frac{4}{5}\).
Here, CP = 5 units and SP = 4 units.
Loss = \(CP - SP = 5 - 4 = 1\) unit.
Loss Percentage \(= \left(\frac{\text{Loss}}{CP}\right) \times 100 = \left(\frac{1}{5}\right) \times 100 = 20\%\).
solution.hi:
दिया गया है: \(CP \text{ का } 20\% = SP \text{ का } 25\%\)
\(\frac{20}{100} \times CP = \frac{25}{100} \times SP \implies \frac{SP}{CP} = \frac{20}{25} = \frac{4}{5}\)।
यहाँ, CP = 5 इकाई और SP = 4 इकाई।
हानि = \(CP - SP = 5 - 4 = 1\) इकाई।
हानि प्रतिशत \(= \left(\frac{\text{हानि}}{CP}\right) \times 100 = \left(\frac{1}{5}\right) \times 100 = 20\%\)।

question.en: An article is sold for a profit of Rs. 50. Profit percentage is 20 percent. What is the cost price of the article? [GD Constable, 08 May 2026, Shift 3]
question.hi: एक वस्तु को 50 रुपये के लाभ पर बेचा जाता है। लाभ प्रतिशत 20 प्रतिशत है। वस्तु का क्रय मूल्य क्या है? [GD Constable, 08 May 2026, Shift 3]

solution.en:
Given, Profit = Rs.50 and Profit Percentage = \(20\%\).
Profit = \(20\% \text{ of Cost Price} = 50\)
\(\frac{20}{100} \times CP = 50 \Rightarrow CP = 50 \times 5 = 250\) रुपये.
solution.hi:
दिया है, लाभ = 50 रुपये और लाभ प्रतिशत = \(20\%\)।
क्रय मूल्य का \(20\% = 50\) रुपये
क्रय मूल्य \((CP) = 50 \times \frac{100}{20} = 250\) रुपये।

question.en: A person sells an article at the profit of 60 percent. Cost price and selling price are increased by 30 percent and 'y' percent respectively. If the new profit percentage is 40 percent, then what is the value of 'y'? [GD Constable, 08 May 2026, Shift 3]
question.hi: एक व्यक्ति एक वस्तु को 60 प्रतिशत के लाभ पर बेचता है। क्रय मूल्य तथा विक्रय मूल्य में क्रमशः 30 प्रतिशत तथा 'y' प्रतिशत की वृद्धि की जाती है। यदि नया लाभ प्रतिशत 40 प्रतिशत है, तो 'y' का मान क्या है? [GD Constable, 08 May 2026, Shift 3]

solution.en:
Let the initial Cost Price (\(CP_1\)) = 100.
Initial Profit = \(60\%\), so initial Selling Price (\(SP_1\)) = 160.
New Cost Price (\(CP_2\)) after \(30\%\) increase = \(100 \times 1.3 = 130\).
New Profit Percentage = \(40\%\).
New Selling Price (\(SP_2\)) = \(130 \times 1.4 = 182\).
Percentage increase in Selling Price (\(y\)) = \(\frac{182 - 160}{160} \times 100 = \frac{22}{160} \times 100 = \frac{220}{16} = 13.75\).

question.en: The selling price of an article is Rs.2400. The profit percentage is 20 percent. What is the cost price of the article? [GD Constable, 09 May 2026, Shift 1]
question.hi:
एक वस्तु का विक्रय मूल्य Rs.2400 है। लाभ का प्रतिशत 20 प्रतिशत है। वस्तु का क्रय मूल्य कितना है?
[ Topic: Profit & Loss ] [GD Constable, 09 May 2026, Shift 1]

solution.en:
Cost Price (\(CP\)) formula when there is a profit:
\(CP = \frac{SP}{100 + \text{Profit}\%} \times 100\)
\(CP =\) Rs.\(\frac{2400}{120} \times 100 =\) Rs.2000.
solution.hi:
लाभ होने पर क्रय मूल्य (\(CP\)) का सूत्र:
\(CP = \frac{SP}{100 + \text{लाभ}\%} \times 100\)
\(CP =\) Rs.\(\frac{2400}{120} \times 100 =\) Rs.2000.

question.en: 40 percent of the cost price of an article is equal to 30 percent of its selling price. What is the profit percentage? [GD Constable, 09 May 2026, Shift 1]
question.hi:
किसी वस्तु के क्रय मूल्य का 40 प्रतिशत उसकी विक्रय मूल्य के 30 प्रतिशत के बराबर है। तो लाभ का प्रतिशत कितना है?
[ Topic: Profit & Loss ] [GD Constable, 09 May 2026, Shift 1]

solution.en:
Given: \(40\% \text{ of } CP = 30\% \text{ of } SP\)
\(40 \times CP = 30 \times SP \implies \frac{SP}{CP} = \frac{40}{30} = \frac{4}{3}\)
Profit = \(SP - CP = 4 - 3 = 1\)
Profit percentage = \(\frac{\text{Profit}}{CP} \times 100 = \frac{1}{3} \times 100 = 33.33\%\).
solution.hi:
दिया गया है: \(40\% \text{ of } CP = 30\% \text{ of } SP\)
\(40 \times CP = 30 \times SP \implies \frac{SP}{CP} = \frac{40}{30} = \frac{4}{3}\)
लाभ = \(SP - CP = 4 - 3 = 1\)
लाभ प्रतिशत = \(\frac{\text{लाभ}}{CP} \times 100 = \frac{1}{3} \times 100 = 33.33\%\)।

question.en: Selling price of an article is Rs. 5625. Profit percentage is 25 percent. What is the cost price of the article? [GD Constable, 09 May 2026, Shift 2]
question.hi:
एक वस्तु का विक्रय मूल्य 5625 रुपये है। लाभ प्रतिशत 25 प्रतिशत है। वस्तु का क्रय मूल्य क्या है?
[ Topic: Profit & Loss ] [GD Constable, 09 May 2026, Shift 2]

solution.en:
Given, \(SP =\) Rs. 5625 and \(\text{Profit} = 25\%\).
\(CP = \frac{SP}{1 + \frac{\text{Profit}\%}{100}} = \frac{5625}{1.25} =\) Rs. 4500.

question.en: A person earns 30 percent profit on selling price. What is the ratio of the value of the profit to the cost price of the article? [GD Constable, 09 May 2026, Shift 2]
question.hi:
एक व्यक्ति को विक्रय मूल्य पर 30 प्रतिशत का लाभ होता है। वस्तु पर हुए लाभ के मान का क्रय मूल्य से अनुपात क्या है?
[ Topic: Ratio & Proportion ] [GD Constable, 09 May 2026, Shift 2]

solution.en:
Let Selling Price (\(SP\)) \(= 100\).
\(\text{Profit} = 30\%\) of \(SP = 30\).
Cost Price (\(CP\)) \(= SP - \text{Profit} = 100 - 30 = 70\).
\(\text{Ratio of Profit to CP} = 30 : 70 = 3 : 7\).

question.en: A person sells an article at the loss of 10 percent. Cost price and selling price both are increased by 20 percent. What will be the new loss percentage? [GD Constable, 09 May 2026, Shift 3]
question.hi:
एक व्यक्ति एक वस्तु को 10 प्रतिशत की हानि पर बेचता है। क्रय मूल्य तथा विक्रय मूल्य दोनों में 20 प्रतिशत की वृद्धि की जाती है। नया हानि प्रतिशत क्या होगा?
[ Topic: Profit & Loss ] [GD Constable, 09 May 2026, Shift 3]

solution.en:
Let original CP = \(100\). Loss is \(10\%\), so original SP = \(90\).
New CP after \(20\%\) increase = \(100 \times 1.2 = 120\).
New SP after \(20\%\) increase = \(90 \times 1.2 = 108\).
New Loss = \(120 - 108 = 12\).
New Loss \(\% = \frac{12}{120} \times 100 = 10\%\). The percentage remains unchanged.

question.en: Selling price of an article is Rs. 3500. If the value of the loss is Rs. 500, then what is the loss percentage? [GD Constable, 09 May 2026, Shift 3]
question.hi:
एक वस्तु का विक्रय मूल्य 3500 रुपये है। यदि हानि का मान 500 रुपये है, तो हानि प्रतिशत क्या है?
[ Topic: Profit & Loss ] [GD Constable, 09 May 2026, Shift 3]

solution.en:
Cost Price (CP) = \(\text{Selling Price (SP)} + \text{Loss} =\) Rs. \(3500 +\) Rs. \(500 =\) Rs. \(4000\).
Loss Percentage = \(\frac{\text{Loss}}{\text{CP}} \times 100 = \frac{500}{4000} \times 100 = 12.5\%\).
solution.hi:
क्रय मूल्य (CP) = \(\text{विक्रय मूल्य (SP)} + \text{हानि} =\) Rs. \(3500 +\) Rs. \(500 =\) Rs. \(4000\)।
हानि प्रतिशत = \(\frac{\text{हानि}}{\text{CP}} \times 100 = \frac{500}{4000} \times 100 = 12.5\%\) है।

question.en: The difference between cost price and selling price of an article is Rs. 385. Profit percentage is 7 percent. What is the cost price of the article? [GD Constable, 18 May 2026, Shift 1]
question.hi: किसी वस्तु के क्रय मूल्य तथा विक्रय मूल्य के बीच का अंतर 385 रुपये है। लाभ प्रतिशत 7 प्रतिशत है। वस्तु का क्रय मूल्य क्या है? [GD Constable, 18 May 2026, Shift 1]

solution.en:
Since there is a profit, \(\text{Selling Price} - \text{Cost Price} = \text{Profit} =\) Rs.385.
Profit percentage is given as \(7\%\) of Cost Price (CP).
So, \(7\% \text{ of } CP = 385\)
\(\frac{7}{100} \times CP = 385 \Rightarrow CP = \frac{385 \times 100}{7} = 55 \times 100 =\) Rs.5500.
solution.hi:
चूंकि लाभ हुआ है, \(\text{विक्रय मूल्य} - \text{क्रय मूल्य} = \text{लाभ} =\) Rs.385.
लाभ प्रतिशत क्रय मूल्य (CP) का \(7\%\) दिया गया है।
तो, \(7\% \text{ of } CP = 385\)
\(\frac{7}{100} \times CP = 385 \Rightarrow CP = \frac{385 \times 100}{7} = 55 \times 100 =\) Rs.5500.

question.en: Selling price of an article is Rs. 2300. If the value of the loss is Rs. 200, then what is the loss percentage? [GD Constable, 18 May 2026, Shift 1]
question.hi: एक वस्तु का विक्रय मूल्य 2300 रुपये है। यदि हानि का मान 200 रुपये है, तो हानि प्रतिशत क्या है? [GD Constable, 18 May 2026, Shift 1]

solution.en:
Given: \(\text{Selling Price (SP)} =\) Rs.2300, \(\text{Loss} =\) Rs.200.
We know that \(\text{Cost Price (CP)} = SP + \text{Loss} = 2300 + 200 =\) Rs.2500.
\(\text{Loss Percentage} = \left(\frac{\text{Loss}}{CP}\right) \times 100 = \left(\frac{200}{2500}\right) \times 100 = \frac{200}{25} = 8\%\).
solution.hi:
दिया गया है: \(\text{विक्रय मूल्य (SP)} =\) Rs.2300, \(\text{हानि} =\) Rs.200.
हम जानते हैं कि \(\text{क्रय मूल्य (CP)} = SP + \text{हानि} = 2300 + 200 =\) Rs.2500.
\(\text{हानि प्रतिशत} = \left(\frac{\text{हानि}}{CP}\right) \times 100 = \left(\frac{200}{2500}\right) \times 100 = \frac{200}{25} = 8\%\)।

question.en: Ratio of the cost price of an article to the selling price of the article is 2: 5. Profit is Rs. 900. What is the cost price of the article? [GD Constable, 18 May 2026, Shift 2]
question.hi: किसी वस्तु के क्रय मूल्य का वस्तु के विक्रय मूल्य से अनुपात 2:5 है। लाभ 900 रुपये हुआ है। वस्तु का क्रय मूल्य क्या है? [GD Constable, 18 May 2026, Shift 2]

solution.en:
Let \(CP = 2x\) and \(SP = 5x\). Profit = \(SP - CP = 5x - 2x = 3x\).
Given profit = Rs.900 \(\implies 3x = 900 \implies x = 300\).
Cost price = \(2x = 2 \times 300 =\) Rs.600.
solution.hi: माना क्रय मूल्य = \(2x\) और विक्रय मूल्य = \(5x\)। लाभ = \(5x - 2x = 3x\)। दिया गया है लाभ = Rs.900 \(\implies 3x = 900 \implies x = 300\)। क्रय मूल्य = \(2 \times 300 =\) Rs.600।

question.en: A person earns 20 percent profit on selling price. What is the ratio of the value of the profit to the cost price of the article? [GD Constable, 18 May 2026, Shift 2]
question.hi: एक व्यक्ति को विक्रय मूल्य पर 20 प्रतिशत का लाभ होता है। वस्तु पर हुए लाभ के मान का क्रय मूल्य से अनुपात क्या है? [GD Constable, 18 May 2026, Shift 2]

solution.en:
Let the Selling Price (\(SP\)) be Rs.100. Profit = \(20\%\text{ of } 100 =\) Rs.20.
Cost Price (\(CP\)) = \(SP - \text{Profit} = 100 - 20 =\) Rs.80.
Ratio of Profit to \(CP = 20 : 80 = 1 : 4\).

question.en: The ratio of the cost price and selling price of an item is 2 : 5. The profit is Rs.210. What will be the selling price of the item? [GD Constable, 18 May 2026, Shift 3]
question.hi: किसी वस्तु के क्रय मूल्य और विक्रय मूल्य का अनुपात 2 : 5 है। लाभ Rs.210 है। वस्तु का विक्रय मूल्य कितना होगा? [GD Constable, 18 May 2026, Shift 3]

solution.en:
Let \(CP = 2x\) and \(SP = 5x\).
\(\text{Profit} = SP - CP = 5x - 2x = 3x\).
Given \(3x = 210 \implies x = 70\).
Selling Price (\(SP\)) = \(5x = 5 \times 70 = 350\).
solution.hi:
माना कि \(CP = 2x\) और \(SP = 5x\) है।
\(\text{लाभ} = SP - CP = 5x - 2x = 3x\) है।
दिया है \(3x = 210 \implies x = 70\) है।
विक्रय मूल्य (\(SP\)) = \(5x = 5 \times 70 = 350\) है।

question.en: The selling price of an item is Rs.4200. If the profit value is Rs.200, then what will be the profit percentage? [GD Constable, 18 May 2026, Shift 3]
question.hi: किसी वस्तु का विक्रय मूल्य Rs.4200 है। यदि लाभ का मान Rs.200 है, तो लाभ प्रतिशत कितना होगा? [GD Constable, 18 May 2026, Shift 3]

solution.en:

Cost price \(CP = SP - \text{Profit} = 4200 - 200 = 4000\).
\(\text{Profit Percentage} = \frac{\text{Profit}}{CP} \times 100 = \frac{200}{4000} \times 100 = 5\%\).

क्रय मूल्य \(CP = SP - \text{लाभ} = 4200 - 200 = 4000\) है।

question.en: 5 times of selling price of an article is equal to 4 times of cost price of the article. What is the loss percentage? [GD Constable, 19 May 2026, Shift 1]
question.hi: किसी वस्तु के विक्रय मूल्य का 5 गुना, वस्तु के क्रय मूल्य के 4 गुना के बराबर है। हानि प्रतिशत क्या है? [GD Constable, 19 May 2026, Shift 1]

question.en: The cost price of 15 articles is Rs.182. The selling price of 20 articles is Rs.182. What is the ratio of the value of profit/loss on 1 article to the cost price of 1 article? (The cost price of all articles is same. The selling price of all articles is same.) [GD Constable, 19 May 2026, Shift 1]
question.hi: 15 वस्तुओ का क्रय मूल्य 182 रुपये है। 20 वस्तुओं का विक्रय मूल्य 182 रुपये है। 1 वस्तु पर हुए लाभ /हानि के मान का 1 वस्तु के क्रय मूल्य से अनुपात क्या है? (सभी वस्तुओ का क्रय मूल्य समान है। सभी वस्तुओं का विक्रय मूल्य समान है।) [GD Constable, 19 May 2026, Shift 1]

solution.en:
Given: \(CP \text{ of } 15 \text{ articles} = SP \text{ of } 20 \text{ articles} = \text{Rs.}182\).
Thus, \(15 \times CP = 20 \times SP \implies \frac{SP}{CP} = \frac{15}{20} = \frac{3}{4}\).
Let \(CP = 4\) and \(SP = 3\).
Since \(SP < CP\), there is a loss.
Loss on 1 article = \(CP - SP = 4 - 3 = 1\).
Ratio of loss to cost price = \(\frac{\text{Loss}}{CP} = \frac{1}{4}\) or 1:4.
solution.hi:
दिया गया है: \(15 \text{ वस्तुओं का } CP = 20 \text{ वस्तुओं का } SP = \text{Rs.}182\)।
अतः, \(15 \times CP = 20 \times SP \implies \frac{SP}{CP} = \frac{15}{20} = \frac{3}{4}\)।
मान लीजिए \(CP = 4\) और \(SP = 3\)।
चूंकि \(SP < CP\) है, इसलिए हानि होगी।
1 वस्तु पर हानि = \(CP - SP = 4 - 3 = 1\)।
हानि का क्रय मूल्य से अनुपात = \(\frac{\text{हानि}}{CP} = \frac{1}{4}\) यानी 1:4.

question.en: Selling price of an article is Rs. 4400. If the value of profit is Rs. 400, then what is the profit percentage? [GD Constable, 19 May 2026, Shift 3]
question.hi: एक वस्तु का विक्रय मूल्य 4400 रुपये है। यदि लाभ का मान 400 रुपये है, तो लाभ प्रतिशत क्या है? [GD Constable, 19 May 2026, Shift 3]

solution.en:
Selling Price (\(SP\)) = Rs. 4400, Profit = Rs. 400.
Cost Price (\(CP\)) = \(SP - Profit = 4400 - 400 = 4000\).
Profit % = \((\frac{Profit}{CP}) \times 100 = (\frac{400}{4000}) \times 100 = 10\%\).

question.en: Cost price of an article is Rs. 480. The profit percentage is 10 percent. What is the value of profit? [GD Constable, 28 Apr 2026, Shift 3]
question.hi: एक वस्तु का क्रय मूल्य 480 रुपये है। लाभ प्रतिशत 10 प्रतिशत है। लाभ का मान क्या है? [GD Constable, 28 Apr 2026, Shift 3]

solution.en:
**Formula:** Profit = $$\text{Cost Price} \times \frac{\text{Profit Percentage}}{100}$$.
$$\text{Profit} = 480 \times \frac{10}{100} = 48\text{ rupees}$$.

question.en: A person has a loss of 25 percent on selling price. What will be his loss percentage on the cost price? [GD Constable, 28 Apr 2026, Shift 3]
question.hi: एक व्यक्ति को विक्रय मूल्य पर 25 प्रतिशत की हानि होती है। क्रय मूल्य पर उसका हानि प्रतिशत क्या होगा? [GD Constable, 28 Apr 2026, Shift 3]

solution.en:
Let Selling Price (SP) = 100.
Loss = 25% of SP = 25.
$$\text{Cost Price (CP)} = \text{SP} + \text{Loss} = 100 + 25 = 125$$.
Loss percentage on CP $$= \frac{\text{Loss}}{\text{CP}} \times 100 = \frac{25}{125} \times 100 = 20\%$$.
solution.hi:
मान लें कि विक्रय मूल्य (SP) = 100 है।
हानि = SP का 25% = 25.
$$\text{क्रय मूल्य (CP)} = \text{SP} + \text{हानि} = 100 + 25 = 125$$.
CP पर हानि प्रतिशत $$= \frac{\text{हानि}}{\text{CP}} \times 100 = \frac{25}{125} \times 100 = 20\%$$.

question.en: 40 percent of the cost price of an article is equal to 50 percent of its selling price. What is the loss percentage? [GD Constable, 29 Apr 2026, Shift 1]
question.hi: किसी वस्तु के क्रय मूल्य का 40 प्रतिशत उसके विक्रय मूल्य के 50 प्रतिशत के बराबर है। हानि प्रतिशत क्या है? [GD Constable, 29 Apr 2026, Shift 1]

solution.en:
Given \(40\% \text{ of CP} = 50\% \text{ of SP} \implies 4 \text{ CP} = 5 \text{ SP} \implies \frac{\text{SP}}{\text{CP}} = \frac{4}{5}\).
Loss percentage \(= \frac{\text{CP} - \text{SP}}{\text{CP}} \times 100 = \frac{5 - 4}{5} \times 100 = 20\%\).
solution.hi:
दिया गया है \(40\% \text{ of CP} = 50\% \text{ of SP} \implies 4 \text{ CP} = 5 \text{ SP} \implies \frac{\text{SP}}{\text{CP}} = \frac{4}{5}\)।
हानि प्रतिशत \(= \frac{\text{CP} - \text{SP}}{\text{CP}} \times 100 = \frac{5 - 4}{5} \times 100 = 20\%\)।

question.en: A person earns 30 percent profit on selling price. What will be his profit percentage on the cost price? [GD Constable, 29 Apr 2026, Shift 1]
question.hi: एक व्यक्ति को विक्रय मूल्य पर 30 प्रतिशत का लाभ होता है। क्रय मूल्य पर उसका लाभ प्रतिशत क्या होगा? [GD Constable, 29 Apr 2026, Shift 1]

solution.en:
Let the selling price (SP) be 100. Profit \(= 30\).
Cost Price (CP) \(= \text{SP} - \text{Profit} = 100 - 30 = 70\).
Profit percentage on CP \(= \frac{30}{70} \times 100 \approx 42.86\%\).
solution.hi:
माना विक्रय मूल्य (SP) 100 है। लाभ \(= 30\)।
क्रय मूल्य (CP) \(= 100 - 30 = 70\)।
क्रय मूल्य पर लाभ प्रतिशत \(= \frac{30}{70} \times 100 \approx 42.86\%\)।

question.en: A person sells an article at the profit of 10 percent. Cost price and selling price both are decreased by 20 percent. What will be the new profit percentage? [GD Constable, 29 Apr 2026, Shift 3]
question.hi: एक व्यक्ति एक वस्तु को 10 प्रतिशत के लाभ पर बेचता है। क्रय मूल्य तथा विक्रय मूल्य दोनों में 20 प्रतिशत की कमी की जाती है। नया लाभ प्रतिशत क्या होगा? [GD Constable, 29 Apr 2026, Shift 3]

solution.en: Let original CP \(= 100\), then original SP \(= 110\). If both decrease by \(20\%\), the new CP \(= 80\) and new SP \(= 110 \times 0.80 = 88\). The new profit value is \(88 - 80 = 8\). New profit percentage \(= \frac{8}{80} \times 100 = 10\%\). The percentage remains unchanged.

question.en: Cost price of 20 articles is Rs. 260. Selling price of 25 articles is Rs. 260. What is the profit/loss percentage? (Cost price of all the articles is same. Selling price of all the articles is same.) [GD Constable, 29 Apr 2026, Shift 3]
question.hi: 20 वस्तुओ का क्रय मूल्य 260 रुपये है। 25 वस्तुओ का विक्रय मूल्य 260 रुपये है। लाभ / हानि प्रतिशत क्या है? (सभी वस्तुओ का क्रय मूल्य समान है। सभी वस्तुओ का विक्रय मूल्य समान है।) [GD Constable, 29 Apr 2026, Shift 3]

solution.en: CP of 1 article \(= \frac{260}{20} = 13\). SP of 1 article \(= \frac{260}{25} = 10.4\). Since SP is less than CP, it is a loss. Loss value \(= 13 - 10.4 = 2.6\). Loss percentage \(= \frac{2.6}{13} \times 100 = 20\%\).

question.en: Selling price and cost price of an article is Rs. 550 and Rs. 500 respectively. What is the profit percentage? [GD Constable, 30 Apr 2026, Shift 1]
question.hi: एक वस्तु का विक्रय मूल्य तथा क्रय मूल्य क्रमशः 550 रुपये तथा 500 रुपये है। लाभ प्रतिशत क्या है? [GD Constable, 30 Apr 2026, Shift 1]

solution.en: Profit \(= \text{SP} - \text{CP} = 550 - 500 = 50\) rupees. Profit percentage \(= \frac{\text{Profit}}{\text{CP}} \times 100 = \frac{50}{500} \times 100 = 10\%\).

question.en: A person earns a loss of 30 percent on selling price. What will be his loss percentage on the cost price? [GD Constable, 30 Apr 2026, Shift 1]
question.hi: एक व्यक्ति को विक्रय मूल्य पर 30 प्रतिशत की हानि होती है। क्रय मूल्य पर उसका हानि प्रतिशत क्या होगा? [GD Constable, 30 Apr 2026, Shift 1]

solution.en: Let the selling price (SP) be 100. Loss \(= 30\). Cost Price (CP) \(= \text{SP} + \text{Loss} = 100 + 30 = 130\). Loss percentage on CP \(= \frac{\text{Loss}}{\text{CP}} \times 100 = \frac{30}{130} \times 100 = \frac{300}{13} \approx 23.08\%\).
solution.hi: माना विक्रय मूल्य (SP) 100 है। हानि \(= 30\)। क्रय मूल्य (CP) \(= \text{SP} + \text{हानि} = 100 + 30 = 130\)। CP पर हानि प्रतिशत \(= \frac{\text{हानि}}{\text{CP}} \times 100 = \frac{30}{130} \times 100 = \frac{300}{13} \approx 23.08\%\)।

question.en: A person sells an item at a profit of 30 percent. Both the cost price and selling price are reduced by 40 percent. What will be the new profit percentage? [GD Constable, 30 Apr 2026, Shift 2]
question.hi: एक व्यक्ति एक वस्तु को 30 प्रतिशत के लाभ पर बेचता है। क्रय मूल्य और विक्रय मूल्य दोनों में 40 प्रतिशत की कमी की जाती है। नया लाभ प्रतिशत कितना होगा? [GD Constable, 30 Apr 2026, Shift 2]

solution.en:
Let initial Cost Price (\(CP_1\)) = 100.
Profit is 30%, so initial Selling Price (\(SP_1\)) = 130.
Both are reduced by 40%:
New Cost Price (\(CP_2\)) = \(100 - 40\% \text{ of } 100 = 60\).
New Selling Price (\(SP_2\)) = \(130 - 40\% \text{ of } 130 = 130 - 52 = 78\).
New Profit = \(78 - 60 = 18\).
New Profit Percentage = \(\frac{18}{60} \times 100 = 30\%\).
The profit percentage remains unchanged.

question.en: The cost price of 30 items is Rs.260. The selling price of 40 items is Rs.260. What is the profit/loss percentage? (The cost price of all items is the same. The selling price of all items is the same.) [GD Constable, 30 Apr 2026, Shift 2]
question.hi: 30 वस्तुओं का क्रय मूल्य Rs.260 है। 40 वस्तुओं का विक्रय मूल्य Rs.260 है। लाभ/हानि प्रतिशत कितना है? (सभी वस्तुओं का क्रय मूल्य समान है। सभी वस्तुओं का विक्रय मूल्य समान है।) [GD Constable, 30 Apr 2026, Shift 2]

solution.en:
Given: \(CP \text{ of } 30 \text{ items} = SP \text{ of } 40 \text{ items}\).
\(\frac{CP}{SP} = \frac{40}{30} = \frac{4}{3}\).
Since CP > SP, there is a loss.
Loss = \(4 - 3 = 1\).
Loss percentage = \(\frac{1}{CP} \times 100 = \frac{1}{4} \times 100 = 25\%\).
solution.hi:
दिया है: \(CP \text{ of } 30 \text{ items} = SP \text{ of } 40 \text{ items}\)।
\(\frac{CP}{SP} = \frac{40}{30} = \frac{4}{3}\)।
चूंकि CP > SP है, इसलिए हानि हुई है।
हानि = \(4 - 3 = 1\)।
हानि प्रतिशत = \(\frac{1}{CP} \times 100 = \frac{1}{4} \times 100 = 25\%\)।

question.en:
A trader sells two articles at the same selling price. On one, he makes 10% profit, on the other, he incurs 10% loss. What is his overall profit or loss on the entire transaction?
[MTS, 04 Feb 2025, Shift 3]
question.hi:
एक व्यापारी एक ही विक्रय मूल्य पर दो वस्तु बेचता है। एक वस्तु पर उसे 10% प्रॉफिट होता है, दूसरी वस्तु पर उसे 10% की हानि होती है। पूरे लेनदेन पर उसका कुल लाभ या हानि ज्ञात कीजिए।
[MTS, 04 Feb 2025, Shift 3]

solution.en:
When SP is same and profit% = loss%, there is always a loss.
$$\text{Loss\%} = \left(\frac{10}{10}\right)^2 = 1\%$$
solution.hi:
जब SP समान हो और लाभ% = हानि% हो, तो हमेशा हानि होती है।
$$\text{हानि\%} = \left(\frac{10}{10}\right)^2 = 1\%$$
---

question.en: Rajesh purchases 30 dozen pens at a rate of Rs 475 per dozen. He sells each pen for Rs 66. What is his total profit or loss percentage? [MTS, 09 Feb 2025, Shift 1]
question.hi: राजेश 475 रुपये प्रति दर्जन की दर से 30 दर्जन पेन खरीदता है। वह हर पेन 66 रुपये में बेचता है। उसका कुल लाभ या हानि प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए। [MTS, 09 Feb 2025, Shift 1]

solution.en:
Cost price = 30 dozen × 475 = 14250
Total pens = 30 × 12 = 360
Selling price = 360 × 66 = 23760
Profit = 23760 - 14250 = 9510
Profit% = (9510/14250) × 100 = 66.73% (approx.)
Shortcut: Profit% = ((SP - CP)/CP) × 100

question.en: A man sells 36 bags for Rs 3600, which results in a 20% loss. How many bags must he sell for Rs 3200 to make a 60% profit? [MTS, 11 Feb 2025, Shift 1]
question.hi: एक आदमी 36 बैग 3600 रुपये में बेचता है, जिससे उसे 20% की हानि होती है। 60% लाभ कमाने के लिए उसे 3200 रुपये में कितने बैग बेचने होंगे? [MTS, 11 Feb 2025, Shift 1]

solution.en: Loss 20% ⇒ SP = 80% of CP ⇒ CP for 36 bags = 3600/0.8 = 4500 ⇒ CP per bag = 4500/36 = 125; for 60% profit, SP per bag = 1.6×125 = 200; bags for Rs 3200 = 3200/200 = 16.

question.en: Sanjay sells a book to Harshit, making an 11% profit. Harshit then sells the book to Anil for a 12% profit. If Anil paid Rs.12,432 for the book, what was the original price Sanjay paid for it? [MTS, 12 Feb 2025, Shift 1]
question.hi: संजय ने हर्षित को एक किताब बेची, जिससे उसे 11% का लाभ हुआ। फिर हर्षित ने किताब को अनिल को 12% के लाभ पर बेच दिया। अगर अनिल ने किताब के लिए Rs.12,432 चुकाए, तो संजय ने इसके लिए असली कीमत क्या दी थी? [MTS, 12 Feb 2025, Shift 1]

solution.en: Let Sanjay's cost price = x. After 11% profit, Harshit buys at 1.11x. After 12% profit, Anil pays 1.12 × 1.11x = 1.2432x. Given 1.2432x = 12432 ⇒ x = 12432/1.2432 = 10000.

question.en: A dealer makes a profit equal to the selling price of 4 pens when he sells a total of 12 pens. What is his profit percentage? [MTS, 13 Feb 2025, Shift 1]
question.hi: एक डीलर कुल 12 पेन बेचकर 4 पेन के विक्रय मूल्य के बराबर लाभ कमाता है। उसका लाभ प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए। [MTS, 13 Feb 2025, Shift 1]

solution.en: Let selling price per pen = s. Total SP = 12s. Profit = 4s, so total CP = 12s - 4s = 8s. Profit% = (Profit/CP)×100 = (4s/8s)×100 = 50%.
solution.hi: प्रति पेन विक्रय मूल्य s मानें। कुल SP = 12s। लाभ = 4s, अतः कुल CP = 12s - 4s = 8s। लाभ% = (लाभ/CP)×100 = (4s/8s)×100 = 50%।

question.en: A shopkeeper buys 120 pens at a rate of 4 pens for Rs.5. He buys another 120 pens at a different rate of 2 pens for Rs.3. He then mixes all the pens and sells them at a rate of 3 pens for Rs.8. What is his overall profit or loss percentage? [MTS, 16 Feb 2025, Shift 1]
question.hi: एक दुकानदार Rs.5 में 4 पेन के दर पर 120 पेन खरीदता है। वह Rs.3 में 2 पेन के दर पर 120 और पेन खरीदता है। वह फिर सभी पेन को मिला देता है और उन्हें Rs.8 में 3 पेन के हिसाब से बेचता है। उसका कुल लाभ या हानि प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए। [MTS, 16 Feb 2025, Shift 1]

solution.en: Cost1: 4 pens for Rs.5 ⇒ 1 pen = Rs.5/4; so 120 pens cost = 120×5/4 = Rs.150. Cost2: 2 pens for Rs.3 ⇒ 1 pen = Rs.3/2; so 120 pens cost = 120×3/2 = Rs.180. Total CP = Rs.330 for 240 pens. Selling: 3 pens for Rs.8 ⇒ 1 pen = Rs.8/3; so SP = 240×8/3 = Rs.640. Profit = 640 - 330 = Rs.310. Profit% = (310/330)×100 = 93.93% (approx).

question.en: 300 kg of rice was purchased at the rate of Rs.20 per kg and sold at a profit of 5%. Compute the profit and the selling price per kg. [MTS, 16 Feb 2025, Shift 2]
question.hi: 300 kg चावल Rs.20 प्रति kg की दर से खरीदा गया और 5% के लाभ पर बेचा गया। लाभ तथा प्रति kg विक्रय मूल्य की गणना कीजिए। [MTS, 16 Feb 2025, Shift 2]

solution.en: Cost price = 300 × 20 = Rs.6000. Profit = 5% of 6000 = Rs.300. Selling price total = 6000 + 300 = Rs.6300, so selling price per kg = 6300/300 = Rs.21.

question.en: Sanskrti purchased a book and sold it at a profit of 10%. If she had bought it at 20% less than the original cost price and sold it for Rs.50 more than the original selling price, then her profit percentage would have been 40%. Find the cost price of the book. [MTS, 17 Feb 2025, Shift 1]
question.hi: संस्कृति ने एक पुस्तक खरीदी और उसे 10% लाभ पर बेच दिया। यदि उसने इसे मूल क्रय मूल्य से 20% कम पर खरीदा होता और मूल विक्रय मूल्य से Rs.50 अधिक पर बेचा होता, तो उसका लाभ प्रतिशत 40% होता। पुस्तक का क्रय मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए। [MTS, 17 Feb 2025, Shift 1]

solution.en: Let CP = x. Original SP = 1.1x. New CP = 0.8x, new SP = 1.1x + 50. Profit 40% ⇒ new SP = 1.4(0.8x)=1.12x. So 1.1x + 50 = 1.12x ⇒ 50 = 0.02x ⇒ x = 2500.

question.en: An item is sold at a 16% profit. If the selling price had been Rs.105 less, the seller would have incurred a 12% loss. If the same item is sold for Rs.350, what is the profit or loss percentage? [MTS, 17 Feb 2025, Shift 1]
question.hi: एक आइटम 16% लाभ पर बेचा जाता है। यदि विक्रय मूल्य Rs.105 कम होता, तो विक्रेता को 12% की हानि होती। यदि वही आइटम Rs.350 में बेचा जाता है, तो लाभ या हानि प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए। [MTS, 17 Feb 2025, Shift 1]

question.en: An article is sold for a loss of 40 percent. What is the ratio of the selling price of the article to the cost price of the article? [MTS, 17 Feb 2025, Shift 2]
question.hi: एक वस्तु को 40 प्रतिशत की हानि पर बेचा जाता है। वस्तु के विक्रय मूल्य का वस्तु के क्रय मूल्य से अनुपात क्या है? [MTS, 17 Feb 2025, Shift 2]

solution.en: Loss 40% ⇒ SP = 60% of CP. So SP:CP = 60:100 = 3:5.

question.en: A man sells an article at a 15% loss. If he had sold it for Rs.450 more, he would've made a 20% profit. What is the cost price of the article? [MTS, 17 Feb 2025, Shift 3]
question.hi: एक व्यक्ति एक वस्तु 15% की हानि पर बेचता है। यदि उसने इसे Rs.450 अधिक में बेचा होता तो उसे 20% लाभ होता। वस्तु का लागत मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए। [MTS, 17 Feb 2025, Shift 3]

solution.en: Let CP = x. SP at 15% loss = 0.85x. SP at 20% profit = 1.20x. Difference = 1.20x - 0.85x = 0.35x = 450 ⇒ x = 450/0.35 = 1285.71.

question.en: An article is sold for a profit of Rs. 81. Profit percentage is 18 percent. What is the cost price of the article? [MTS, 18 Feb 2025, Shift 1]
question.hi: एक वस्तु को 81 रुपये के लाभ पर बेचा जाता है। लाभ प्रतिशत 18 प्रतिशत है। वस्तु का क्रय मूल्य क्या है? [MTS, 18 Feb 2025, Shift 1]

question.en: 10 percent of the cost price of an article is equal to the 15 percent of its selling price. What is the loss percentage? [MTS, 18 Feb 2025, Shift 1]
question.hi: किसी वस्तु के क्रय मूल्य का 10 प्रतिशत उसके विक्रय मूल्य के 15 प्रतिशत के बराबर है। हानि प्रतिशत क्या है? [MTS, 18 Feb 2025, Shift 1]

question.en: Ravi purchases 9 apples for Rs.9.60 and sells them at the rate of 11 apples for Rs.12. Determine his overall profit or loss percentage. [MTS, 18 Feb 2025, Shift 2]
question.hi: रवि 9 सेब Rs.9.60 में खरीदता है और उन्हें 11 सेब Rs.12 की दर पर बेचता है। उसका कुल लाभ या हानि प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए। [MTS, 18 Feb 2025, Shift 2]

question.en: An article is sold for a profit of Rs. 180. Profit percentage is 40 percent. What is the selling price of the article? [MTS, 18 Feb 2025, Shift 3]
question.hi: एक वस्तु को 180 रुपये के लाभ पर बेचा जाता है। लाभ प्रतिशत 40 प्रतिशत है। वस्तु का विक्रय मूल्य क्या है? [MTS, 18 Feb 2025, Shift 3]

solution.en: Profit = 40% of CP. So 0.40 × CP = 180 ⇒ CP = 180/0.40 = 450. Selling price SP = CP + Profit = 450 + 180 = 630.

question.en: Ratio of the cost price of an article to the selling price of the article is 4 : 3. Loss is Rs. 182. What is the cost price of the article? [MTS, 19 Feb 2025, Shift 1]
question.hi: किसी वस्तु के क्रय मूल्य का वस्तु के विक्रय मूल्य से अनुपात 4 : 3 है। हानि 182 रुपये हुई है। वस्तु का क्रय मूल्य क्या है? [MTS, 19 Feb 2025, Shift 1]

solution.en: Let CP=4k and SP=3k. Loss = CP−SP = k = 182 ⇒ k=182. Hence CP=4k=4×182=728.

question.en: Total cost price of 300 articles is Rs. 150. Total selling price of 8 articles is Rs. 5. What is the profit percentage? (Cost price of all the articles is same. Selling price of all the articles is same.) [MTS, 19 Feb 2025, Shift 1]
question.hi: 300 वस्तुओं का कुल क्रय मूल्य 150 रुपये है। 8 वस्तुओं का कुल विक्रय मूल्य 5 रुपये है। लाभ प्रतिशत क्या है? (सभी वस्तुओं का क्रय मूल्य समान है। सभी वस्तुओं का विक्रय मूल्य समान है।) [MTS, 19 Feb 2025, Shift 1]

solution.en: CP per article = 150/300 = 0.5. SP per article = 5/8 = 0.625. Profit per article = 0.625−0.5 = 0.125. Profit% = (0.125/0.5)×100 = 25%.

question.en: A person earns 20 percent profit on selling price. What will be his profit percentage on the cost price? [MTS, 19 Feb 2025, Shift 3]
question.hi: एक व्यक्ति को विक्रय मूल्य पर 20 प्रतिशत का लाभ होता है। क्रय मूल्य पर उसका लाभ प्रतिशत क्या होगा? [MTS, 19 Feb 2025, Shift 3]

solution.en: Profit is 20% of SP. Let SP = 100 ⇒ Profit = 20 ⇒ CP = 100 - 20 = 80. Profit% on CP = (20/80)×100 = 25%.

question.en: An article is sold for a loss of 25 percent. What is the ratio of the selling price of the article to the cost price of the article? [MTS, 19 Feb 2025, Shift 2]
question.hi: एक वस्तु को 25 प्रतिशत की हानि पर बेचा जाता है। वस्तु के विक्रय मूल्य का वस्तु के क्रय मूल्य के सापेक्ष अनुपात क्या है? [MTS, 19 Feb 2025, Shift 2]

solution.en: Loss 25% ⇒ SP = 75% of CP. So SP : CP = 75 : 100 = 3 : 4.
solution.hi: 25% हानि पर SP = 75% of CP। अतः SP : CP = 75 : 100 = 3 : 4।

question.en: Selling price of an article is Rs. 306. Loss percentage is 40 percent. What is the cost price of the article? [MTS, 20 Feb 2025, Shift 1]
question.hi: एक वस्तु का विक्रय मूल्य 306 रुपये है। हानि प्रतिशत 40 प्रतिशत है। वस्तु का क्रय मूल्य क्या है? [MTS, 20 Feb 2025, Shift 1]

solution.en: Loss 40% ⇒ SP \(=60\%\) of CP; \(306=0.60×\text{CP}\Rightarrow \text{CP}=306/0.60=510\).

question.en: The profit earned on selling an article for Rs. 1100 is 29 times of the loss incurred on selling the same article for Rs. 800. What will be the selling price of the article to earn a profit of 10 percent? [MTS, 20 Feb 2025, Shift 1]
question.hi: किसी वस्तु को 1100 रुपये में बेचने पर हुआ लाभ, उसी वस्तु को 800 रुपये में बेचने पर हुई हानि का 29 गुना है। 10 प्रतिशत लाभ कमाने के लिए उस वस्तु का विक्रय मूल्य क्या होगा? [MTS, 20 Feb 2025, Shift 1]

solution.en: Let CP \(=x\); profit at 1100 \(=1100-x\), loss at 800 \(=x-800\); given \(1100-x=29(x-800)\Rightarrow 1100-x=29x-23200\Rightarrow 24300=30x\Rightarrow x=810\); for 10% profit, SP \(=1.10×810=891\).

question.en: The ratio of selling price of an article to the cost price of the article is 9 : 11. What is the loss percentage? [MTS, 20 Feb 2025, Shift 2]
question.hi: किसी वस्तु के विक्रय मूल्य का वस्तु के क्रय मूल्य से अनुपात 9 : 11 है। हानि प्रतिशत क्या है? [MTS, 20 Feb 2025, Shift 2]

question.en: Total cost price of 1600 articles is Rs. 300. Total selling price of 10 articles is Rs. 3. What is the profit percentage? (Cost price of all the articles is same. Selling price of all the articles is same.) [MTS, 20 Feb 2025, Shift 2]
question.hi: 1600 वस्तुओं के कुल क्रय मूल्य 300 रुपये हैं। 10 वस्तुओं के कुल विक्रय मूल्य 3 रुपये हैं। लाभ प्रतिशत क्या है? (सभी वस्तुओं का क्रय मूल्य समान है। सभी वस्तुओं का विक्रय मूल्य समान है।) [MTS, 20 Feb 2025, Shift 2]

question.en: The profit obtained by selling a bicycle for Rs.840 is the same as the loss incurred if it is sold for Rs.760. What will be the percentage profit if the bicycle is sold for Rs.900? [Selection Post Phase XIII (Graduate), 02 Aug 2025, Shift 3]
question.hi: एक साइकिल को Rs.840 में बेचने पर प्राप्त लाभ, Rs.760 में बेचने पर होने वाली हानि के समान है। यदि साइकिल को Rs.900 में बेचा जाए तो लाभ प्रतिशत क्या होगा? [Selection Post Phase XIII (Graduate), 02 Aug 2025, Shift 3]

solution.en:
When profit at one price equals loss at another, the cost price lies exactly midway.
**CP = \(\frac{SP_1 + SP_2}{2}\)**
CP = \(\frac{840 + 760}{2}\) = 800
Profit at Rs.900 = 900 − 800 = 100
Profit% = \(\frac{100}{800} \times 100\) = **\( 12.5\% \)**
**Ans: (2) \( 12.5\% \)**

question.en: By selling 5 chairs for Rs.1200, a carpenter gains the cost price of 2 chairs. The profit percent is: [Selection Post Phase XIII (Graduate), 24 Jul 2025, Shift 3]
question.hi: 5 कुर्सियों को Rs.1200 में बेचने पर, एक बढ़ई को 2 कुर्सियों के क्रय मूल्य के बराबर लाभ होता है। लाभ प्रतिशत है: [Selection Post Phase XIII (Graduate), 24 Jul 2025, Shift 3]

solution.en:
Selling price of 5 chairs = cost price of 5 chairs + cost price of 2 chairs, so it equals the cost of 7 chairs.
Thus the gain on 5 chairs is the cost of 2 chairs.
**Profit% = \(\frac{Gain}{CP} \times 100\)**
Profit% = \(\frac{2}{5} \times 100\) = **40%**
**Ans: (3) 40%**
solution.hi:
5 कुर्सियों का विक्रय मूल्य = 5 कुर्सियों का क्रय मूल्य + 2 कुर्सियों का क्रय मूल्य, अर्थात 7 कुर्सियों की लागत के बराबर।
अतः 5 कुर्सियों पर लाभ 2 कुर्सियों की लागत के बराबर है।
**लाभ% = \(\frac{Gain}{CP} \times 100\)**
लाभ% = \(\frac{2}{5} \times 100\) = **40%**
**उत्तर: (3) 40%**

question.en: A milkman bought 50 liters of milk for Rs.2000. 5 liters of milk spoiled. At what rate per liter should he sell the remaining milk to make a profit of 20% on his total outlay? [Selection Post Phase XIII (Graduate), 25 Jul 2025, Shift 3]
question.hi: एक दूधवाले ने Rs.2000 में 50 लीटर दूध खरीदा। 5 लीटर दूध खराब हो गया। उसे शेष दूध को प्रति लीटर किस दर पर बेचना चाहिए कि उसे अपने कुल व्यय पर 20% का लाभ हो? [Selection Post Phase XIII (Graduate), 25 Jul 2025, Shift 3]

solution.en:
**Required SP = Total cost × \(\frac{100 + profit\%}{100}\)**
Required total selling price = 2000 × 1.2 = 2400
Milk left for sale = 50 − 5 = 45 litres
Rate = \(\frac{2400}{45}\) = **Rs.53.33 per liter**
**Ans: (1) Rs.53.33 per liter**
solution.hi:
**अभीष्ट विक्रय मूल्य = कुल लागत × \(\frac{100 + profit\%}{100}\)**
अभीष्ट कुल विक्रय मूल्य = 2000 × 1.2 = 2400
बचा हुआ दूध = 50 − 5 = 45 लीटर
दर = \(\frac{2400}{45}\) = **Rs.53.33 प्रति लीटर**
**उत्तर: (1) Rs.53.33 प्रति लीटर**

question.en: A shopkeeper claims to sell goods at a profit of 10% on the cost price but uses a false weight of 900 g for every 1 kg. What is his actual profit percentage? [Selection Post Phase XIII (Graduate), 28 Jul 2025, Shift 3]
question.hi: एक दुकानदार लागत मूल्य पर 10% लाभ पर सामान बेचने का दावा करता है लेकिन प्रत्येक 1 किलोग्राम के लिए 900 ग्राम का गलत वजन इस्तेमाल करता है। उसका वास्तविक लाभ प्रतिशत क्या है? [Selection Post Phase XIII (Graduate), 28 Jul 2025, Shift 3]

solution.en:
For Rs.100 worth of goods (at cost) he actually hands over only 900 g in place of 1 kg, so he charges the price of 1 kg for goods costing him 900 g.
**Actual profit factor = \(\frac{True\ weight}{False\ weight} \times \frac{100 + profit\%}{100}\)**
Factor = \(\frac{1000}{900} \times 1.10\) = 1.2222
Actual profit = **22.22%**
**Ans: (2) 22.22%**
solution.hi:
वह 1 किग्रा के स्थान पर केवल 900 ग्राम देता है, अर्थात 900 ग्राम की लागत वाली वस्तु पर 1 किग्रा का मूल्य वसूलता है।
**वास्तविक लाभ गुणक = \(\frac{True\ weight}{False\ weight} \times \frac{100 + profit\%}{100}\)**
गुणक = \(\frac{1000}{900} \times 1.10\) = 1.2222
वास्तविक लाभ = **22.22%**
**उत्तर: (2) 22.22%**

question.en: A person sells 50 chairs for Rs.10,000, suffering a loss of 15%. Estimate how many chairs should he sell for Rs.9000 to make a profit of 10%? [Selection Post Phase XIII (Graduate), 29 Aug 2025, Shift 1]
question.hi: एक व्यक्ति 50 कुर्सियाँ Rs.10,000 में बेचता है, जिससे उसे 15% की हानि होती है। अनुमान लगाइए कि उसे Rs.9000 में कितनी कुर्सियाँ बेचनी चाहिए ताकि उसे 10% का लाभ हो? [Selection Post Phase XIII (Graduate), 29 Aug 2025, Shift 1]

solution.en:
**CP = \(\frac{SP \times 100}{100 - loss\%}\)**
Total cost of 50 chairs = \(\frac{10000}{0.85}\) = 11764.71, so cost of one chair = 235.29
For a 10% profit, selling price per chair = 235.29 × 1.1 = 258.82
Number of chairs = \(\frac{9000}{258.82}\) ≈ **35**
**Ans: (2) 35**

question.en: A baker made 100 cakes for Rs.3000. Due to an accident, 10 cakes were damaged. At what price per cake should he sell the remaining cakes to make an overall profit of 15%? [Selection Post Phase XIII (Graduate), 29 Jul 2025, Shift 3]
question.hi: एक बेकर ने Rs.3000 में 100 केक बनाए। दुर्घटना के कारण 10 केक खराब हो गए। शेष केक को प्रति केक किस कीमत पर बेचना चाहिए ताकि उसे कुल 15% का लाभ हो? [Selection Post Phase XIII (Graduate), 29 Jul 2025, Shift 3]

solution.en:
**Required SP = Total cost × \(\frac{100 + profit\%}{100}\)**
Required total selling price = 3000 × 1.15 = 3450
Cakes left = 100 − 10 = 90
Price per cake = \(\frac{3450}{90}\) = **Rs.38.33**
**Ans: (4) Rs.38.33**

question.en: The profit made on an item sold for Rs.2200 is equal to the loss incurred when it is sold for Rs.1800. What will be the profit or loss percentage if the item is sold for Rs.2050? [Selection Post Phase XIII (Graduate), 30 Jul 2025, Shift 3]
question.hi: Rs.2200 में बेची गई वस्तु पर हुआ लाभ Rs.1800 में बेचने पर हुई हानि के बराबर है। यदि वस्तु Rs.2050 में बेची जाए तो लाभ या हानि प्रतिशत क्या होगा? [Selection Post Phase XIII (Graduate), 30 Jul 2025, Shift 3]

question.en: A shopkeeper finds that the profit from selling a watch for Rs.1100 is equal to the loss incurred when selling it for Rs.900. What will be the percentage loss if the watch is sold for Rs.850? [Selection Post Phase XIII (Graduate), 31 Jul 2025, Shift 3]
question.hi: एक दुकानदार को पता चलता है कि एक घड़ी को Rs.1100 में बेचने पर उसे जो लाभ हुआ वह उसे Rs.900 में बेचने पर हुई हानि के बराबर है। यदि घड़ी को Rs.850 में बेचा जाए तो हानि का प्रतिशत क्या होगा? [Selection Post Phase XIII (Graduate), 31 Jul 2025, Shift 3]

question.en: A shopkeeper earns 70% profit on selling an article. If he increases the selling price by Rs. 338, the profit becomes 83%. Find the cost price. [Selection Post Phase XIII (12th), 02 Aug 2025, Shift 2]
question.hi: एक दुकानदार एक वस्तु को बेचकर 70% लाभ कमाता है। अगर वह बिक्री कीमत में 338 रुपये की वृद्धि करता है, तो लाभ 83% हो जाता है। लागत कीमत ज्ञात कीजिए। [Selection Post Phase XIII (12th), 02 Aug 2025, Shift 2]

solution.en:
The profit rises from 70% to 83%, so the extra Rs.338 is 13% of the cost price.
**CP = \(\frac{Increase \times 100}{Increase\ in\ profit\%}\)**
CP = \(\frac{338 \times 100}{13}\) = **Rs. 2600**
**Ans: (1) Rs. 2600**
solution.hi:
लाभ 70% से बढ़कर 83% हुआ, अतः अतिरिक्त Rs.338 क्रय मूल्य का 13% है।
**क्रय मूल्य = \(\frac{Increase \times 100}{Increase\ in\ profit\%}\)**
क्रय मूल्य = \(\frac{338 \times 100}{13}\) = **Rs. 2600**
**उत्तर: (1) Rs. 2600**

question.en: A bookstore buys 2,000 books for Rs.180 each. They offer a "Buy 4, Get 1 Free" scheme but sell at the marked price of Rs.225 per book. What is their effective profit percentage per book sold (after adjusting for the free books)? [Selection Post Phase XIII (12th), 24 Jul 2025, Shift 2]
question.hi: एक बुकस्टोर 2,000 पुस्तकें Rs.180 प्रति पुस्तक के भाव से खरीदता है। वे "4 खरीदें, 1 मुफ़्त पाएं" योजना पेश करते हैं, लेकिन प्रति पुस्तक Rs.225 के अंकित मूल्य पर बेचते हैं। प्रति पुस्तक बेची गई उनकी प्रभावी लाभ प्रतिशत क्या है (मुफ़्त पुस्तकों को समायोजित करने के बाद)? [Selection Post Phase XIII (12th), 24 Jul 2025, Shift 2]

solution.en:
Take one set of the scheme: 5 books are given away for the price of 4.
Cost of 5 books = 5 × 180 = 900 and revenue = 4 × 225 = 900
**Profit% = \(\frac{SP - CP}{CP} \times 100\)**
Profit% = \(\frac{900 - 900}{900} \times 100\) = **0%**
**Ans: (1) 0%**

question.en: A trader buys 150 mobile phones at Rs.8,000 each. He finds 10% of the phones defective and sells them at a 50% discount (on cost price). The rest are sold at a 10% profit. What is his overall profit or loss? [Selection Post Phase XIII (12th), 25 Jul 2025, Shift 2]
question.hi: एक व्यापारी 150 मोबाइल फोन Rs.8,000 प्रति फोन की दर से खरीदता है। उसे 10% फोन खराब लगते हैं और वह उन्हें 50% छूट (क्रय मूल्य पर) पर बेच देता है। शेष फोन 10% लाभ पर बेचे जाते हैं। उसका कुल लाभ या हानि क्या है? [Selection Post Phase XIII (12th), 25 Jul 2025, Shift 2]

solution.en:
Total cost = 150 × 8000 = 12,00,000
Defective phones = 10% of 150 = 15, sold at half of cost → loss = 15 × 4000 = 60,000
Remaining 135 phones sold at 10% profit → profit = 135 × 8000 × 0.10 = 1,08,000
**Overall profit = Total gain − Total loss**
Overall = 108000 − 60000 = **Rs.48,000**
**Ans: (1) Rs.48,000**

question.en: What percentage profit is made when the selling price of 12 pens covers the cost price of 27 pens? [Selection Post Phase XIII (12th), 25 Jul 2025, Shift 2]

question.en: An online seller purchases a laptop at Rs.40,000. He lists it at a 25% markup. solution.en:
Listed price = 40000 × 1.25 = 50,000 and after a 10% discount the selling price = 45,000
Total cost including shipping = 40000 + 500 = 40,500
**Profit% = \(\frac{SP - CP}{CP} \times 100\)**

**Ans: (2) 11.11%**

4.hi: कोई समग्र लाभ या हानि नहीं

question.en: The cost price of 12 articles is the same as the selling price of 8 articles. What is the profit percent? [Selection Post Phase XIII (10th), 01 Aug 2025, Shift 3]

**उत्तर: (4) 50%**

question.en: <!-- x-tinymce/html -->A man sells two articles for Rs.4000 each On one, he gains 25%, and on the other, he loses 25% What is his net gain or loss percentage in the entire transaction? [Selection Post Phase XIII (10th), 29 Aug 2025, Shift 3]
question.hi: एक आदमी दो वस्तुएं Rs.4000 प्रति वस्तु की दर से बेचता है। एक पर उसे 25% का लाभ होता है, तथा दूसरी पर उसे 25% की हानि होती है। पूरे लेन-देन में उसका शुद्ध लाभ या हानि प्रतिशत क्या है? [Selection Post Phase XIII (10th), 29 Aug 2025, Shift 3]

solution.en:
When the two selling prices are equal and the gain and loss percentages are the same, the deal always ends in a loss.
**Loss% = \(\frac{x^2}{100}\), where x is the common percentage**
Loss% = \(\frac{25 \times 25}{100}\) = **6.25% loss**
**Ans: (2) 6.25% loss**
solution.hi:

**हानि% = \(\frac{x^2}{100}\), जहाँ x उभयनिष्ठ प्रतिशत है**
हानि% = \(\frac{25 \times 25}{100}\) = **6.25% हानि**

question.en: A vendor bought 100 oranges at Rs.8 each. He sold 80 of them at Rs.10 each and the remaining 20 oranges at Rs.6 each. What is his overall profit or loss percentage? [Selection Post Phase XIII (10th), 31 Jul 2025, Shift 1]

question.en: A mobile phone retailer sells a phone for Rs.P and earns a profit of 20%. For a special festive offer, he marks the same phone at Rs.1.5P. At the offer, he provides a discount of 10%. What will be the percentage profit that he will make during the festive offer? [CGL, 12 Sep 2025, Shift 3]
question.hi: एक मोबाइल फोन रिटेलर एक फोन Rs.P में बेचता है और 20% का लाभ कमाता है। एक विशेष त्योहारी ऑफर के लिए, वह उसी फोन को Rs.1.5P पर बेचता है। ऑफर पर, वह 10% की छूट देता है। त्योहारी ऑफर के दौरान उसे कितना प्रतिशत लाभ होगा? [CGL, 12 Sep 2025, Shift 3]

solution.en:
Selling price Rs.P gives 20% profit, so cost price \(= \frac{P}{1.2}\)
In the festive offer, marked price = 1.5P and discount = 10%
**Selling price = Marked price × (100 − discount%) ÷ 100**
New selling price = 1.5P × 0.9 = 1.35P
Profit% \(= \frac{1.35P - \frac{P}{1.2}}{\frac{P}{1.2}} = 1.35 \times 1.2 - 1 = 0.62\)
**Profit = 0.62 (i.e. 62%)**
**Ans: (3) 0.62**

question.en: A shopkeeper marked an item 25% above its cost price. During a sale, he offered a discount of 10%. What was his profit percentage? [CGL, 12 Sep 2025, Shift 3]
